title: Virasoro Constraints under Projectivization
main_claim: For a smooth projective B and any vector bundle E of rank r≥2, the full Virasoro constraints V(B) (all genera, all curve classes, odd/primitive insertions, exact L_0 constant) imply V(P_B(E)).
coverage: Read sections 1-3 and 5-8 in full and the first half of section 4 (localization). Checked by hand: the equivariant projective-bundle relation and fixed restrictions (p|_B=-λ); the Iritani fixed-point multipliers for weights ±1 (factors x+λ and (x-λ-z)^{-1}); the Seidel reduction T_a mod (z,Q^{>0}) = (p+λ)⋆ including the degree argument; the quantum fiber relation p^r(p+λ)=y; the spectral picture (B branch at 0, X cluster at λ); the divided B-block eigenvalue (-λ)^{-r}; [G_d,T_d]=0 (Euler degrees W_F and the conjugation E_z c E_z^{-1}=c+W_F z); the functional-calculus commutator [f(T),λ]=z(ξf')(T) and the removal of λ-derivatives in D_i; the Euler action on log Δ_F (½ per root and -x/z); the Bernoulli difference Φ(v±z)-Φ(v); the flow e^{tH} for H=z∂_λ-Θ'; the formula for b_F; Δ_F=a^{n/2}exp(-log a·c_N/z)Δ_{F,0}, with C/z central for the modes; rank scaling ħ→ħ/m_F against Riemann–Roch rank n(1-g)+∫c_N; the critical values (-r)^rλ^{r+1}/(r+1)^{r+1}; monodromy transitivity; ancestor-bound finiteness of the coefficient tests; the normal-ordering scalar -½str(1/4-μ²)=-2C_Y; and the scalar-removal corollary.

issues.location: Sec. 4 (loc:factorization, leg-family gluing and obstruction-theory compatibility)
issues.description: The extension of Coates–Givental–Tseng ancestor localization to positive-dimensional families of orbit lines (root gerbes over X) is argued in outline. The fixed/moving splitting of the glued tangent complex and the claim that the fixed part is the diagonal virtual pullback are asserted from a normalization triangle without full detail.
issues.evidence: The text says it 'supplies ... the leg-moduli and virtual-class details left open in [CGT, Remark 3.7]', but the compatibility step is given in a few sentences around (loc:tangent-gluing).

issues.description: The fixed-point formula for the shift operator, together with its sign and calibration conventions (S_Y(z)=M(-z)^{-1}, z→-z), is imported from Iritani with only a brief check. The internal consistency checks I ran (degree 1 and the Seidel element at y=0) agree with it.
issues.evidence: Cited as the 'projective specialization' of several statements in [IritaniShift]; not re-derived.
